title: KV stabilizer: onboarding simulation and rollback safety for long-context workloads
creator: Anya Patel
description:
Summary: We need a deterministic preflight and simulation harness (the 'KV stabilizer') to validate KV-cache performance profiles for newly onboarded model versions across heavy long-context and tail-sequence distributions. This ticket covers building the sim harness, running a set of synthetic + sampled production traces, defining safety thresholds for automated version pinning/rollback, and integrating a publish decision flag for the profile registry.

Why: Recent onboarding runs surfaced unstable tail latency regressions when KV retention and prefetch heuristics changed. These regressions only appear on low-frequency, long-prefix sequences and were missed by average-latency tests. The stabilizer will detect unstable variance, estimate rollback risk, and create an annotated artifact for the profiler publish workflow.

Scope:
- Implement a simulation harness that replays sequences against the new model variant with realistic KV cache behavior (prefetch, eviction, and warmstart).
- Support two input classes: synthetic heavy-tail generators and sampled production traces (with PII stripped).
- Produce per-sequence distribution metrics: token-latency quantiles (p50/p90/p99/p999), KV hit-rate, cold-start frequency, and memory delta.
- Define thresholds and a risk score to recommend: publish as-is, publish with conservative retention, or block/pin to previous version.
- Add a rollback-safety check that simulates automatic fallback traffic routing and measures expected degradation under worst-case tail latency.
- Integrate summary output into the profile registry entry (metadata flag: stabilizer_result=pass/warn/fail) and into the console onboarding panel.

Non-goals: automated remediation of model binaries, changes to production routing logic (only recommendations), extended CI integration beyond the runtime preflight job for now.
acceptance_criteria: Sim harness (python) that can replay sequences with KV semantics against a runtime test image and produce JSON report
Reports include p50/p90/p99/p999 token latencies, KV hit-rate, cold-start counts, memory delta per sequence
Risk scoring logic documented and implemented (score -> pass/warn/fail) with configurable thresholds
Integration: report attached to the model profile registry entry and stabilizer_result visible in the console onboarding UI
Runbook: steps to re-run sim against any candidate model version and interpret the report
Automated test: smoke job in CI that executes sim for a tiny sample trace and verifies exit codes for pass/warn/fail
comments: 2026-03-01 - Anya Patel: Created ticket after post-mortem for ENG-66120 where a small percentage of long-seq requests saw 2.4x token latency. Proposed a scoped sim rather than full traffic shadowing to avoid customer risk.
2026-03-03 - Miguel Alvarez: Spike started. Implemented core replay harness prototype (link below). Initial results show p999 differences concentrated in sequences with repeated long-prefix prompts.

2026-03-05 - Miguel Alvarez: Added synthetic heavy-tail generator (Pareto alpha tunable) to model infrequent long tails. Verified KV hit-rate behavior matches sampled traces within 7% for p99 latency.

2026-03-07 - Design review with PM (Ruth Kim): Decided to expose stabilizer_result values (pass/warn/fail) in onboarding UI with tooltip guidance. PM requested a lightweight explanation string for each result.

2026-03-09 - Security (Priya Shah): Confirmed sampling pipeline for production traces can use existing PII-removal job before ingestion to sim. No extra security review required for initial sim harness.
2026-03-11 - QA (Jamal Reed): Added CI smoke job under runtime/preflight that runs sim against a tiny fixed seed trace. Failure modes documented. QA will run a longer job for canary candidates.
2026-03-12 - Miguel Alvarez: Draft PR opened. Next: add registry integration and console flag. Planning to demo to the onboarding squad on 2026-03-15.
implementation_notes: Harness will use the runtime test-image `runtime:canary-2026-03` and the existing local kv-sim shim to model eviction/prefetch latencies.
Prefer reproducible seeds for synthetic generator; store seed in the report to allow deterministic replays.
Risk scoring should combine latency regression magnitude (p99/p999 deltas) and cold-start frequency into a single 0-100 score; thresholds configurable via feature flag.
Console integration: add an 'Automated Stabilizer' section in the onboarding review with short human-readable summary and link to full JSON report.
Registry metadata: add fields stabilizer_score and stabilizer_result to the model profile manifest; ensure backward compatibility if absent.
Create follow-up ENG ticket for automated reroute experiments only after 2 successful real onboarding runs with stabilizer_result=pass.
Create a short playbook for on-call describing what to do if a published profile later shows tail regressions (include roll-forward and emergency pin instructions).
